# [PR #19562] [None][infra] Reuse PLC pipeline result if commit not changed

source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/19562
state: open | updated: 2026-09-23T01:20:01Z

## 正文

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Dev Engineer Review
The Jenkins pipeline now reuses a cached PLC source scan result when the commit matches a completed `/LLM/helpers/PLCScanningSetup` build with `scanMode=pre_merge` and `runSourceCodeScanning=true`.
The OSS Compliance Check skips a new PLC build when cached data exists. It uses the cached result and URL instead.
If no cache exists, it still triggers the same PLC job with the same parameters.
`UNSTABLE` still does not fail the check. Other non-`SUCCESS` results still fail it.
Risk is limited to cache selection and result reuse. The cache lookup uses the first matching completed build.

## QA Engineer Review
No test changes.

## Per-File QA Perspective
- `jenkins/L0_MergeRequest.groovy`: Verify that a rerun with the same commit reuses a prior PLC scan result. Verify that a new commit still launches a fresh PLC scan. Verify that `UNSTABLE` remains non-fatal and that other downstream failures still fail the stage.
